parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by kinetic energy.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: A cannon fires a shell vertically upwards. The shell leaves the cannon with a speed of $80\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and a kinetic energy of $480\text{ J}$. The shell then rises to a maximum height of $210\text{ m}$. The effect of air resistance is significant.
parts.text: Show that the mass of the shell is $0.15\text{ kg}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
(b)(ii)1 For the movement of the shell from the cannon to its maximum height, calculate

1. the gain in gravitational potential energy,

(b)(ii)2 2. the work done against air resistance.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the average force due to the air resistance acting on the shell as it moves from the cannon to its maximum height.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
(b)(v)
parts.text:
The force due to the air resistance is a vector quantity.

Compare the force due to the air resistance acting on the shell as it rises with the force due to the air resistance as it falls.
